nav.title: Files
nav.description: A tree of real files, and the one you clicked — plain, resizable columns, no panels.

nav.title: Layout
nav.description: A toolbar over anything, and a drawer that pushes the page over to make room.

nav.title: Mention
nav.description: `#Page` and `@owner` become a small icon + the word, wherever the site renders written content.

nav.title: Panel
